calibration_evaluator.contract: Callable[[Mapping[str, Any], CalibrationEvidence], float] injected through an explicit owner-reviewed binding; no dynamic config imports; not registered in production until owner approval
inputs: one reviewable stage-3 draft with >=1 candidate parameter set (weights + maximize) and all four explicit component bindings
one hash-pinned, owner-approved VALIDATION-only evidence artifact: schema_version=1, split=validation, approved=true, 18 unique episode_ids, explicit source_hashes, measurement_class
an evaluator callable registered under registered_calibration_evaluator_v1
outputs: one finite scalar score per candidate
recommended_candidate_id and recommended_parameters under registered_evaluator_max_score_then_candidate_id (max score, then candidate_id tie-break)
a CalibrationProposal explicitly labelled selection_statistic_not_independent_evaluation with provenance recording independent_evaluation=false
calibration_evaluator.evidence: the frozen 18-episode VALIDATION outcomes referenced by the evidence artifact; collection and approval are separate decisions, and the proposal never writes or approves parameters
calibration_evaluator.fail_closed: rejects unapproved evidence, tampered source hashes, TEST/TRAIN paths, non-finite scores, unpermitted parameter keys, empty candidate grids and any missing binding
calibration_evaluator.prohibition: the selection statistic is not an independent estimate of post-calibration performance and does not fix the numeric weights; weights and ranking direction stay VALIDATION-selected and owner-approved
